name: Your Takeout
detailed_description:
Will you sink in the quagmire of human nature, or be reborn on the pyre of sin?

SEVEN ENDS

Genre: Exploration-based puzzle walking simulator psychological horror game / Single-player FPS (First-Person Shooter)
Engine: Built with cutting-edge technology of ​Unreal Engine 5
Development: Developed solo by a Chinese indie game enthusiast

​Key Features

  • ​Hyper-realistic immersion: Experience a chilling ​body-cam perspective with photorealistic graphics and spatial audio reverberation effects that blur the line between game and reality.

  • ​Urban nightmare: Plunged into a dark, silent urban village, every breath and move brings them face-to-face with fear and death.

  • ​Survival mechanics: Players must confront the threats of horrifying creatures, overcome their inner fears, stay vigilant, and meticulously explore the environment to solve puzzles.

  • ​Escape or perish: Uncover the secrets buried in the decaying alleys, complete nerve-shredding tasks, and find the path to freedom… before the village consumes your sanity.

In a textile factory, three homicides are woven into a web:

Seven people's sins, seven people's redemption, three unsolved mysteries—pride, lust, greed... Heavy transgressions entangle here, and the only ransom turns out to be new deaths? With each tick of the clock drawing closer, the threads of truth strangle rather than breathe—what exactly is coiled here: the hope of life, or the noose of death?

​Key Features

🔹 ​True-to-life environments: Neon-soaked alleyways, claustrophobic tenements, and grimy gambling dens.
🔹 ​Optimized performance: Smooth gameplay even on lower-end hardware.
🔹 ​Gripping narrative: A non-linear montage narrative with ​bone-chilling endings that haunt your choices.
🔹 ​Seamless puzzles: Environmental riddles woven into the decaying urban fabric.
🔹 ​Bite-sized intensity: Beat the core story in ​40-60 minutes; unlock all endings in ​1-2 hour.
